# SurajWood (Suraj Wood Products Pvt. Ltd.)

> India's premier manufacturer of prelaminated PMMA acrylic panels, 3D seamless membrane shutters, decorative laminates, and architectural aluminum profiles.

SurajWood is an ISO-certified architectural surface and hardware manufacturer based in Bahadurgarh, Haryana, India. We specialize in optical-grade PMMA acrylic sheets bonded with German Polyurethane Reactive (PUR) hotmelt technology, 3D seamless vacuum thermoformed membrane shutters on Green HDHMR, decorative laminates, and precision 6063-T5 architectural aluminum profiles.

## Core Product Portfolio (4 Pillars)

### 1. Prelaminated Acrylic Panels (PMMA)
- [ACRYLUX High-Gloss](https://www.surajwood.com/products/acrylux): Flagship 95%+ high-gloss prelaminated acrylic panels with 37+ solid, metallic, and wood-grain colors. 3H scratch resistance, zero orange-peel, and German PUR hot-melt bonding.
- [ACRYSILK Soft-Satin](https://www.surajwood.com/products/acrysilk): Micro-textured soft satin acrylic surface with advanced nano anti-fingerprint protection.
- [ACRYMATTE Nano-Matte](https://www.surajwood.com/products/acrymatte): Deep ultra-matte acrylic panels featuring German nano anti-fingerprint coating.
- [ACRYGLASS High-Gloss](https://www.surajwood.com/products/acryglass): Mirror-like high-gloss acrylic panels offering 95% light reflectivity and genuine glass-like depth.
- [ACRYGLASS MATTE](https://www.surajwood.com/products/acryglass-matte): Optical-grade glass clarity combined with a velvety frosted matte surface.

### 2. 3D Seamless Membrane Shutters & Doors
- [3D Membrane Shutters](https://www.surajwood.com/products/membrane-shutters): 3D vacuum thermoformed cabinet doors with 100% monolithic 5-sided seamless wrap and zero edge-banding seams.
  - **Core**: High-Density Moisture Resistant Green HDHMR (850+ kg/m³) / E1 MDF.
  - **Polymer Foil**: 0.45mm UV-stabilized heavy European PVC foil thermoformed at 120°C with German PUR adhesive.
  - **Shade Palette (36 Finishes)**: Wood Grain (WG - 9 oak & walnut textures), Porcelain Touch (PT - 13 velvety matte shades), Perfect Silk (PS - 7 soft satin colors), Ceramic Satin (CS - 7 mineral textures).
  - **CNC Profiles**: Classic Shaker Door, Integrated J-Pull Handleless, Fluted Ribbed 3D Texture, Beveled Chamfer Edge.

### 3. AL-PROFHAN Architectural Aluminum Profiles
- [AL-PROFHAN Aluminum Profiles](https://www.surajwood.com/products/aluminum-profiles): Precision-engineered 6063-T5 architectural aluminum profiles supplied in continuous 3.0-meter (10 ft) lengths with 1.2mm–1.5mm wall thickness.
  - **Finishes**: 5 architectural finishes (Black Brush Anodized, Bronze Brush Anodized, Coffee Painted, Anthracite Painted, Champagne Painted).
  - **Series**: Ottimo Series (handleless Gola & C/L profile handles with rubber gasket damper channels), Aerolinea Series (slim glass shutter frames & T-patti edge trims), Handle Profiles (PAPS-1336, PAPS-5677 J-pull, PAPS-1335), Shelf Profiles (PAPS-5037 LED glass shelf profiles), Hanging Rod (PAPS-6413 LED wardrobe rod), Luminare Series (PAPS-3136A 45° and PAPS-3062A recessed LED channels), Velaro Series (luxury sliding glass shutters).

### 4. Laminates & Decorative Panels
- [Decorative Panels & Laminates](https://www.surajwood.com/products): High-pressure decorative laminates, synchronized wood textures, anti-bacterial surfaces, and matching edge-banding solutions for commercial and residential cabinetry.

## Applications
- [Modular Kitchens](https://www.surajwood.com/applications/kitchens): Moisture-proof, Class B1 fire-rated panels and handleless Gola profiles engineered for heavy Indian cooking.
- [Luxury Wardrobes](https://www.surajwood.com/applications/wardrobes): Anti-fingerprint, 3H hardness surfaces, floor-to-ceiling Shaker membrane doors, and integrated LED hanging rods.
- [Bathroom Vanities](https://www.surajwood.com/applications/bathroom-vanities): 100% waterproof PUR-bonded panels and seamless membrane doors resistant to steam, splash, and mold.
- [TV Units & Living Consoles](https://www.surajwood.com/applications/tv-units): High-gloss, matte, and fluted panel backdrops.
- [Commercial & Hospitality](https://www.surajwood.com/applications/commercial): Durable, high-traffic surfaces for corporate offices, retail showrooms, and hotels.

## Technical Specifications
- **Surface Quality**: 1.0mm – 1.5mm Optical-Grade PMMA / 0.45mm European PVC Foil.
- **Core Substrates**: Green HDHMR (850 kg/m³), E1-Grade MDF, Calibrated Plywood, Particle Board (PB).
- **Adhesive Bonding**: 100% German Polyurethane Reactive (PUR) Hotmelt (waterproof & heat resistant to 120°C).
- **Scratch Hardness**: 3H Pencil Hardness.
- **Warranty**: 5 to 10 Year Manufacturer Warranty against delamination, bubbling, and color degradation.
